hints.title: Grid Symmetry States
hints.text: A rook movement on n x m partitions all grid cells into 4 symmetric states relative to destination: destination itself (0), same row different column (1), different row same column (2), different row different column (3).

hints.title: State Transition System
hints.text: In each step, a rook can move to m - 1 cells in its row or n - 1 cells in its column.

hints.title: 4-State Step Transition
hints.text: Maintain the counts of reaching each of the 4 states after step s. Update all 4 counts simultaneously modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: 4-state Markov transition chain across k steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Grid BFS takes O((n + m)^k) paths.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reduce grid into 4 equivalence classes and run linear or matrix exponentiation DP.
